description: The only GitHub Actions files the gate's `no GitHub Actions workflows` stage allows (ADR-24 as amended by ADR-41, D-086): `tower-gate.yml`, the tower/gate check of main's merge queue, `deploy-doorbell.yml`, which rings the AWS deploy's doorbell on a merge to main, `full-suite.yml`, the whole script suite after each merge to main (a red run opens an issue), `web.yml`, the site's own checks on apps/web (D-319), and `site-canary.yml`, the read-only live-site synthetic HTTP canary (D-359 Salto 1) (the migration to GitHub, 14/11/2026: the Torre's choice (a), a GitHub-hosted runner, free on a public repository), staged in services/runner/github/ (or services/runner/github/proposed/ before Torre installation) and installed under D-087, never by a session.
